contexts.text: Put on the garments of political ministers... CL 354:2.
(These) are nothing but moral, civil, and political works...
Supereminence by means of (the holy things of the Church) in politics also.
Their hierarchy... upheld by ecclesiastical and at the same time political authority.
In other chambers they talked about... the political state.
The second (novitiate) was a politician.
(The politician states what had been his belief in relation to the life after death.) TCR 160:6.
(The love of dominating from the love of self) with politicians, rises up until they want to be kings and emperors...
The quality of the political love of self, shown.
By influx is meant... all that which precedes with a politician, and composes his prudence.
Political laws are in the second place...
Political things are in the first (or lowest) region of the mind.
Lies and political hypocrisies (are forbidden in the eighth commandment).
Free will in political and natural things is thence.
But civil and political things do not so (remain in man). Explained.
The understanding abiding only in political things which regard a man's life in the dominion where he is...
One of the companies consisted of politicians. (They state their opinions concerning conscience.)
By various political arts and allurements.
The political things of their kingdom occupy the minds and possess the hearts (of the English), sometimes so far as to withdraw their spirits from studies of more lofty judgment...
Without conscience, like many politicians...
The politicians (reason from their own knowledges).
Bed bugs are those theologians who have believed that religion is nothing but a political affair in the world...

The man who has religion, is in political things like a swan flying with a bunch of grapes in its mouth; but he who has not religion is in these things like a basilisk with a poisonous herb in its mouth.
